prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: unique square website favicon for Aura of Intelligence, legible at 32 pixels. Create a polished original stylised three-dimensional mark representing SEVEN nested horn-torus surfaces, all meeting at a single shared central pinch point, on a flat deep dark plum background (#160b20). The horn-torus conceptual relation is R=r; there is no open central bore. Use a slightly oblique three-quarter view, a compact balanced sculptural silhouette, generous empty margin, crisp contours and simplified broad programmable-facet divisions. Seven nested coloured surfaces in outer-to-inner order violet, indigo, blue, green, yellow, orange, red, with restrained pale-gold highlights. Show coherent curved surfaces rather than seven disconnected circular outlines. The coloured nested wireframe displayed on the supplied VerseBox concept screen and the stable faceted address map of Aura Matrix Studio informed this new concept; do not depict any booth, monitor or room. Aim for a memorable calm geometrical intelligence mark, with no crystal, rock, gemstone, geode, eye, iris, pupil, doughnut hole, text, lettering, numbers or watermark. This is a stylised concept, not an exact scientific diagram. Square composition, solid background, no transparency.
